title: DARPA programs with nine-figure budgets going black to Site 51

tellings.quote: I had a DARPA program manager in here named John Bletch and he didn't say this. This is my speculation, but he kept having these programs in certain cases with nine-figure budgets.

plain: Projects at DARPA, the Pentagon's advanced research agency, with budgets of hundreds of millions of dollars, may have gone "black" (into deep secrecy) and moved to Area 51, the secret Air Force test site in Nevada. The physicist John Brandenburg tells Michels that a DARPA programme manager named John Blitch kept having programmes like these with "nine-figure budgets", but he says plainly that Blitch never said where they went: the move to Area 51 is Brandenburg's own speculation.
